cohort: Women with Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) undergoing surgical treatment with hysterectomy at cesarean delivery.
finding: A simple 2-hand technique is proposed to improve surgical outcomes of cesarean hysterectomy for PAS by allowing transection of the cardinal ligament below the placental bed, which is expected to minimize blood loss.
mod_finding: The proposed 2-hand technique is specifically designed for surgical application during cesarean hysterectomy.
